title: zapret2-manager status.json
description: Shape of /tmp/zapret2-manager/status.json produced by usr/libexec/zapret2-manager/status.uc and served (3s cached) by the ubus `status` method. The collector populates every block; the UI renders, never recomputes. Drift, serviceState, and qlenHealth are backend-computed so the watchdog (no UI) sees the same picture a human sees. Schema v3 adds the canonical runtimeSummary projection; extend only by ADDING fields and bumping the `schema` number.

schema.description: Schema version. v3 adds runtimeSummary; extend only by adding fields and bumping this number.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 with timezone (e.g. 2026-07-27T00:07:00Z). null = not collected. All timestamps in this document are ISO-8601 with timezone.

generation.description: Config generation number read from the applied config. null = not present / not checked. The manager does not bump it; upstream does on its own apply.

serviceState.description: Backend-computed, single closed-enum value. paused and passthrough are self-standing states, NOT flags layered on running. paused = the paused indicator is set; passthrough = the no-strategy passthrough profile is active. partial = process up but nft table missing; error = queue not registered / queue jammed / collector failed. The UI maps a value to a badge (presentation only — no threshold/state logic in the UI).

runtime.description: RUNTIME level: what is actually running right now (ps + /proc/<pid>/cmdline + list_table + nft table presence).

instances.description: One entry per running nfqws2 process.

cmdline.description: Actual argv from /proc/<pid>/cmdline, NULs → spaces. Ground truth, not config.

startTime.description: ISO-8601. null = unknown. /proc/<pid> dir mtime ≈ start.

rssKb.description: Resident set size in KB from /proc/<pid>/status (VmRSS). null = not read.

strategies.description: list_table output (the nft table dump the daemon's ruleset currently holds).

profileCount.description: Backend-computed count of non-empty list_table lines. null = not available.

rulesPresent.description: nft table `zapret2` is present and non-empty. Distinct from process presence.

runtimeSummary.description: Canonical additive runtime truth projection consumed by Orchestra and Auto Strategy. unknown means evidence is unavailable; stopped is emitted only for confirmed absence of both process and NFQUEUE.

applied.description: APPLIED level: on-disk intent upstream will honor on next start (/opt/zapret2/config + /etc/config/zapret2 IF it exists).

configMtime.description: ISO-8601 mtime of /opt/zapret2/config. null if absent.

uci.description: uci show zapret2 output. null if /etc/config/zapret2 is absent (confirmed on this installation).

draft.description: DRAFT level: manager's own staged state (/etc/zapret2-manager/state.json). Upstream never reads this. Free-form (active profile, passthrough flag, etc.).

drift.description: Backend-computed divergence between RUNTIME and APPLIED. The UI renders this block; it does NOT recompute drift. Intermediate basis: sha256 of both applied sources captured at apply time, compared each collection. Both sources are accounted, never one alone; an absent source hashes to null and is skipped.

divergent.description: true = running argv does not match applied state.

appliedSha256.description: Hashes captured at apply time (sha256-intermediate basis).

currentSha256.description: Hashes computed this collection, for comparison.

normalizedRuntime.description: Normalized runtime argv (argv-render basis). null under sha256-intermediate.

health.description: Backend-computed health: the NFQUEUE qlen signal (qlenHealth) and a list of discrete checks. The UI renders; it does not apply thresholds (the backend computes state).

qlenHealth.description: The third liveness signal (NFQUEUE 300 depth). Backend-computed; the UI only renders.

state.description: Backend-computed: warn at >threshold, critical after critTurns consecutive over.

consecutiveOverThreshold.description: Consecutive collections queue_total > threshold. Reset to 0 when it drops back.

critTurns.description: Consecutive over-threshold turns that flip state to critical (constant 3).

checks.description: Discrete health checks. Each has an `id` from a CLOSED set. A result field that is null means 'checked, no value'; a result field that is ABSENT means 'not checked'. The UI MUST render those two cases differently.

queue.description: Raw NFQUEUE values for queue 300 (the detail behind qlenHealth). Cycle-based deltas are computed by the watchdog; updatedAt mirrors that.

registered.description: false = the queue is not registered in the kernel (nfqws2 not connected). Distinct from queueTotal=0.

queueTotal.description: Field 3. Instantaneous queue length; threshold 50 + three-consecutive rule apply.

queueDropped.description: Field 6. Cumulative monotonic counter; consume as delta only.

queueUserDropped.description: Field 7. Cumulative monotonic counter; delta only.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 of the watchdog's last qlen cycle.

system.description: System-integration facts: autostart symlinks, upgradable badge.

autostart.description: Informational. Authoritative autostart check is a real reboot (tools/smoke.sh autostart).

upstream.description: Facts about the upstream zapret2 installation: daemon version, autohostlist vars (shown verbatim, no manager thresholds).

nfqws2Version.description: null = checked, no value (distinct from the key being absent = not checked). Resolved: /opt/zapret2/version file, else the binary.

autohostlist.description: AUTOHOSTLIST* vars read as-is from /opt/zapret2/config and shown verbatim. null = no AUTOHOSTLIST vars or config unreadable.

jobs.description: Recent long-running jobs (the ubus job model — see docs/contracts/ubus.md). Empty until the job model lands; the block is present so consumers can rely on the shape.

id.description: Opaque job id; do not parse.

warnings.description: Active, non-fatal warnings the operator should see. Empty when all is well.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable. Closed by convention; new codes added, not renamed.
